verses.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה שְׁמַ֖ע יַעֲקֹ֣ב עַבְדִּ֑י וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּחַ֥רְתִּי בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘aḇ·dî wə·yiś·rā·’êl bā·ḥar·tî ḇōw
verses.literal: But now listen O Jacob My servant Israel whom I have chosen

verses.original: כֹּה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֶׂ֛ךָ וְיֹצֶרְךָ֥ מִבֶּ֖טֶן יַעְזְרֶ֑ךָּ אַל־ תִּירָא֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב עַבְדִּ֣י וִישֻׁר֖וּן בָּחַ֥רְתִּי בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘ō·śe·ḵā wə·yō·ṣer·ḵā mib·be·ṭen ya‘·zə·re·kā ’al- tî·rā ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘aḇ·dî wî·šu·rūn bā·ḥar·tî ḇōw
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD your Maker who formed you from the womb [and] who will help you Do not be afraid O Jacob My servant Jeshurun whom I have chosen

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶצָּק־ מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־ צָמֵ֔א וְנֹזְלִ֖ים עַל־ יַבָּשָׁ֑ה אֶצֹּ֤ק רוּחִי֙ עַל־ זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וּבִרְכָתִ֖י עַל־ צֶאֱצָאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṣ·ṣāq- ma·yim ‘al- ṣā·mê wə·nō·zə·lîm ‘al- yab·bā·šāh ’eṣ·ṣōq rū·ḥî ‘al- zar·‘e·ḵā ū·ḇir·ḵā·ṯî ‘al- ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: For I will pour water on the thirsty land and currents on the dry ground I will pour out My Spirit on your descendants and My blessing on your offspring

verses.original: וְצָמְח֖וּ בְּבֵ֣ין חָצִ֑יר כַּעֲרָבִ֖ים עַל־ יִבְלֵי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·mə·ḥū bə·ḇên ḥā·ṣîr ka·‘ă·rā·ḇîm ‘al- yiḇ·lê- mā·yim
verses.literal: They will sprout among the grass like willows by flowing streams

verses.original: זֶ֤ה יֹאמַר֙ אָ֔נִי לַֽיהוָ֣ה וְזֶ֖ה יִקְרָ֣א בְשֵֽׁם־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְזֶ֗ה יִכְתֹּ֤ב יָדוֹ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה יְכַנֶּֽה׃פ וּבְשֵׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: zeh yō·mar ’ā·nî Yah·weh wə·zeh yiq·rā ḇə·šêm- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·zeh yiḵ·tōḇ yā·ḏōw Yah·weh yə·ḵan·neh ū·ḇə·šêm yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: One will say I [belong] to the LORD another will call himself by the name of Jacob and still another will write on his hand The LORD’s and will take the name of Israel

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ וְגֹאֲל֖וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אֲנִ֤י רִאשׁוֹן֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אַחֲר֔וֹן אֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִֽים׃ וּמִבַּלְעָדַ֖י
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh me·leḵ- wə·ḡō·’ă·lōw yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ă·nî ri·šō·wn wa·’ă·nî ’a·ḥă·rō·wn ’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·mib·bal·‘ā·ḏay
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD the King and Redeemer of Israel the LORD of Hosts I am the first and I am the last and there is no God but Me

verses.original: וּמִֽי־ כָמ֣וֹנִי יִקְרָ֗א וְיַגִּידֶ֤הָ וְיַעְרְכֶ֙הָ֙ לִ֔י מִשּׂוּמִ֖י עוֹלָ֑ם עַם־ יַגִּ֥ידוּ לָֽמוֹ׃ וְאֹתִיּ֛וֹת וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֖אנָה
verses.transliteration: ū·mî- ḵā·mō·w·nî yiq·rā wə·yag·gî·ḏe·hā wə·ya‘·rə·ḵe·hā lî miś·śū·mî ‘ō·w·lām ‘am- yag·gî·ḏū lā·mōw wə·’ō·ṯî·yō·wṯ wa·’ă·šer tā·ḇō·nāh
verses.literal: Who then [is] like Me Let him say so Let him declare [his] case before Me since I established an ancient people Let him foretell the things to come and what is to take place

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּפְחֲדוּ֙ וְאַל־ תִּרְה֔וּ הֲלֹ֥א הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֥יךָ וְהִגַּ֖דְתִּי מֵאָ֛ז וְאַתֶּ֣ם עֵדָ֑י הֲיֵ֤שׁ אֱל֙וֹהַּ֙ מִבַּלְעָדַ֔י וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר יָדָֽעְתִּי׃ בַּל־
verses.transliteration: ’al- tip̄·ḥă·ḏū wə·’al- tir·hū hă·lō hiš·ma‘·tî·ḵā wə·hig·gaḏ·tî mê·’āz wə·’at·tem ‘ê·ḏāy hă·yêš ’ĕ·lō·w·ah mib·bal·‘ā·ḏay wə·’ên ṣūr yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî bal-
verses.literal: Do not tremble [or] fear Have I not told you and declared it long ago You are My witnesses Is there any God but Me There is no other Rock I know not one

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ יֹֽצְרֵי־ פֶ֤סֶל תֹּ֔הוּ וַחֲמוּדֵיהֶ֖ם בַּל־ יוֹעִ֑ילוּ וְעֵדֵיהֶ֣ם הֵׄ֗מָּׄהׄ בַּל־ יִרְא֛וּ וּבַל־ יֵדְע֖וּ לְמַ֥עַן יֵבֹֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām yō·ṣə·rê- p̄e·sel tō·hū wa·ḥă·mū·ḏê·hem bal- yō·w·‘î·lū wə·‘ê·ḏê·hem hēm·må̄h bal- yir·’ū ū·ḇal- yê·ḏə·‘ū lə·ma·‘an yê·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: All makers of idols are nothing and the things they treasure vvv are worthless Their witnesses . . . fail to see . . . or comprehend so they are put to shame

verses.original: מִֽי־ יָצַ֥ר אֵ֖ל נָסָ֑ךְ וּפֶ֣סֶל הוֹעִֽיל׃ לְבִלְתִּ֖י
verses.transliteration: mî- yā·ṣar ’êl nā·sāḵ ū·p̄e·sel hō·w·‘îl lə·ḇil·tî
verses.literal: Who fashions a god or casts an idol which profits him nothing

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כָּל־ חֲבֵרָיו֙ יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ וְחָרָשִׁ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה מֵֽאָדָ֑ם כֻלָּם֙ יִֽתְקַבְּצ֤וּ יַֽעֲמֹ֔דוּ יָֽחַד׃ יִפְחֲד֖וּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ
verses.transliteration: hên kāl- ḥă·ḇê·rāw yê·ḇō·šū wə·ḥā·rā·šîm hêm·māh mê·’ā·ḏām ḵul·lām yiṯ·qab·bə·ṣū ya·‘ă·mō·ḏū yā·ḥaḏ yip̄·ḥă·ḏū yê·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: Behold all his companions will be put to shame for the craftsmen themselves are only human Let them all assemble and take their stand they will all be brought to terror and shame

verses.original: חָרַ֤שׁ בַּרְזֶל֙ מַֽעֲצָ֔ד וּפָעַל֙ בַּפֶּחָ֔ם יִצְּרֵ֑הוּ וּבַמַּקָּב֖וֹת וַיִּפְעָלֵ֙הוּ֙ כֹּח֔וֹ בִּזְר֣וֹעַ גַּם־ רָעֵב֙ כֹּ֔חַ וְאֵ֣ין לֹא־ שָׁ֥תָה מַ֖יִם וַיִּיעָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·raš bar·zel ma·‘ă·ṣāḏ ū·p̄ā·‘al bap·pe·ḥām yiṣ·ṣə·rê·hū ū·ḇam·maq·qā·ḇō·wṯ way·yip̄·‘ā·lê·hū kō·ḥōw biz·rō·w·a‘ gam- rā·‘êḇ kō·aḥ wə·’ên lō- šā·ṯāh ma·yim way·yî·‘āp̄
verses.literal: The blacksmith . . . takes a tool and labors over the coals he fashions [an idol] with hammers and forges [it] with his strong arms Yet he grows hungry and loses his strength . . . he fails to drink water and grows faint

verses.original: חָרַ֣שׁ עֵצִים֮ נָ֣טָה קָו֒ יְתָאֲרֵ֣הוּ בַשֶּׂ֔רֶד יַעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ בַּמַּקְצֻע֔וֹת יְתָאֳרֵ֑הוּ וּבַמְּחוּגָ֖ה וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ כְּתַבְנִ֣ית אִ֔ישׁ אָדָ֖ם כְּתִפְאֶ֥רֶת לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·raš ‘ê·ṣîm nā·ṭāh qāw yə·ṯā·’ă·rê·hū ḇaś·śe·reḏ ya·‘ă·śê·hū bam·maq·ṣu·‘ō·wṯ yə·ṯā·’o·rê·hū ū·ḇam·mə·ḥū·ḡāh way·ya·‘ă·śê·hū kə·ṯaḇ·nîṯ ’îš ’ā·ḏām kə·ṯip̄·’e·reṯ lā·še·ḇeṯ bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: The woodworker . . . extends a measuring line he marks it out with a stylus he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass He fashions it in the likeness of man like man in all his glory that it may dwell in a shrine

verses.original: לִכְרָת־ ל֣וֹ אֲרָזִ֔ים וַיִּקַּ֤ח תִּרְזָה֙ וְאַלּ֔וֹן וַיְאַמֶּץ־ ל֖וֹ בַּעֲצֵי־ יָ֑עַר נָטַ֥ע אֹ֖רֶן וְגֶ֥שֶׁם יְגַדֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: liḵ·rāṯ- lōw ’ă·rā·zîm way·yiq·qaḥ tir·zāh wə·’al·lō·wn way·’am·meṣ- lōw ba·‘ă·ṣê- yā·‘ar nā·ṭa‘ ʾō·rɛn wə·ḡe·šem yə·ḡad·dêl
verses.literal: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak He lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest He plants a laurel and the rain makes it grow

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה לְבָעֵ֔ר לְאָדָם֙ וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֵהֶם֙ וַיָּ֔חָם אַף־ יַשִּׂ֖יק וְאָ֣פָה לָ֑חֶם אַף־ יִפְעַל־ אֵל֙ וַיִּשְׁתָּ֔חוּ עָשָׂ֥הוּ פֶ֖סֶל וַיִּסְגָּד־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·ḇā·‘êr lə·’ā·ḏām way·yiq·qaḥ mê·hem way·yā·ḥām ’ap̄- yaś·śîq wə·’ā·p̄āh lā·ḥem ’ap̄- yip̄·‘al- ’êl way·yiš·tā·ḥū ‘ā·śā·hū p̄e·sel way·yis·gāḏ- lā·mōw
verses.literal: It serves as fuel for man He takes some of it to warm himself and he kindles a fire and bakes [his] bread He also fashions it into a god and worships it he makes an idol and bows down to it

verses.original: שָׂרַ֣ף חֶצְיוֹ֙ בְּמוֹ־ אֵ֔שׁ יִצְלֶ֥ה בָּשָׂ֣ר עַל־ חֶצְיוֹ֙ יֹאכֵ֔ל צָלִ֖י וְיִשְׂבָּ֑ע אַף־ יָחֹם֙ וְיֹאמַ֣ר הֶאָ֔ח חַמּוֹתִ֖י רָאִ֥יתִי אֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: śā·rap̄ ḥeṣ·yōw bə·mōw- ’êš yiṣ·leh bā·śār ‘al- ḥeṣ·yōw yō·ḵêl ṣā·lî wə·yiś·bā‘ ’ap̄- yā·ḥōm wə·yō·mar he·’āḥ ḥam·mō·w·ṯî rā·’î·ṯî ’ūr
verses.literal: He burns half of it in the fire and he roasts meat on that half He eats the roast and is satisfied Indeed he warms himself and says Ah I am warm I see the fire

verses.original: וּשְׁאֵ֣רִית֔וֹ עָשָׂ֖ה לְאֵ֥ל לְפִסְל֑וֹ יִסְגּוֹד ל֤וֹ וְיִשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֔יו וְיֹאמַר֙ הַצִּילֵ֔נִי כִּ֥י אָֽתָּה׃ אֵלִ֖י
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·’ê·rî·ṯōw ‘ā·śāh lə·’êl lə·p̄is·lōw yis·gōḏ lōw wə·yiš·ta·ḥū wə·yiṯ·pal·lêl ’ê·lāw wə·yō·mar haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî kî ’āt·tāh ’ê·lî
verses.literal: From the rest he makes a god his graven image He bows down to it . . . and worships he prays to it and says Save me for you are my god

verses.original: לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יָבִ֑ינוּ כִּ֣י טַ֤ח עֵֽינֵיהֶ֔ם מֵֽרְאוֹת֙ לִבֹּתָֽם׃ מֵהַשְׂכִּ֖יל
verses.transliteration: lō yā·ḏə·‘ū wə·lō yā·ḇî·nū kî ṭaḥ ‘ê·nê·hem mê·rə·’ō·wṯ lib·bō·ṯām mê·haś·kîl
verses.literal: They do not comprehend [or] discern for He has shut their eyes so they cannot see and [closed] their minds so they cannot understand

verses.original: וְלֹא־ יָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־ לִבּ֗וֹ וְלֹ֨א דַ֥עַת וְלֹֽא־ תְבוּנָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ שָׂרַ֣פְתִּי חֶצְי֞וֹ בְמוֹ־ אֵ֗שׁ וְ֠אַף אָפִ֤יתִי לֶ֔חֶם עַל־ גֶּחָלָיו֙ אֶצְלֶ֥ה בָשָׂ֖ר וְאֹכֵ֑ל אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה לְתוֹעֵבָ֣ה וְיִתְרוֹ֙ אֶסְגּֽוֹד׃ לְב֥וּל עֵ֖ץ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·šîḇ ’el- lib·bōw wə·lō ḏa·‘aṯ wə·lō- ṯə·ḇū·nāh lê·mōr śā·rap̄·tî ḥeṣ·yōw ḇə·mōw- ’êš wə·’ap̄ ’ā·p̄î·ṯî le·ḥem ‘al- ge·ḥā·lāw ’eṣ·leh ḇā·śār wə·’ō·ḵêl ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lə·ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh wə·yiṯ·rōw ’es·gō·wḏ lə·ḇūl ‘êṣ
verses.literal: And no one considers in his heart no one has the knowledge . . . or insight to say I burned half of it in the fire and I baked bread on its coals I roasted meat and I ate Shall I make something detestable with the rest of it Shall I bow down to a block of wood

verses.original: רֹעֶ֣ה אֵ֔פֶר הוּתַ֖ל לֵ֥ב הִטָּ֑הוּ וְלֹֽא־ יַצִּ֤יל אֶת־ נַפְשׁוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א יֹאמַ֔ר הֲל֥וֹא בִּימִינִֽי׃ס שֶׁ֖קֶר
verses.transliteration: rō·‘eh ’ê·p̄er hū·ṯal lêḇ hiṭ·ṭā·hū wə·lō- yaṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw wə·lō yō·mar hă·lō·w bî·mî·nî še·qer
verses.literal: He feeds on ashes His deluded heart has led him astray and he cannot deliver - himself [or] say Is not this thing in my right hand a lie

verses.original: זְכָר־ אֵ֣לֶּה יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֣י אָ֑תָּה עַבְדִּי־ וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יְצַרְתִּ֤יךָ אַ֔תָּה עֶֽבֶד־ לִי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א תִנָּשֵֽׁנִי׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵār- ’êl·leh ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî ’āt·tāh ‘aḇ·dî- wə·yiś·rā·’êl yə·ṣar·tî·ḵā ’at·tāh ‘e·ḇeḏ- lî yiś·rā·’êl lō ṯin·nā·šê·nî
verses.literal: Remember these things O Jacob for you are My servant O Israel I have made you [and] you are My servant O Israel [I] will never forget [you]

verses.original: מָחִ֤יתִי פְּשָׁעֶ֔יךָ כָעָב֙ חַטֹּאותֶ֑יךָ וְכֶעָנָ֖ן שׁוּבָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י כִּ֥י גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ḥî·ṯî pə·šā·‘e·ḵā ḵā·‘āḇ ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḵe·‘ā·nān šū·ḇāh ’ê·lay kî ḡə·’al·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud and your sins like a mist Return to Me for I have redeemed you

verses.original: רָנּ֨וּ שָׁמַ֜יִם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֣ה הָרִ֙יעוּ֙ תַּחְתִּיּ֣וֹת אָ֔רֶץ פִּצְח֤וּ רִנָּ֔ה הָרִים֙ יַ֖עַר וְכָל־ עֵ֣ץ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֙ גָאַ֤ל יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב יִתְפָּאָֽר׃פ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: rān·nū šā·ma·yim kî- Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh hā·rî·‘ū taḥ·tî·yō·wṯ ’ā·reṣ piṣ·ḥū rin·nāh hā·rîm ya·‘ar wə·ḵāl ‘êṣ bōw kî- Yah·weh ḡā·’al ya·‘ă·qōḇ yiṯ·pā·’ār ū·ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Sing for joy O heavens for the LORD has done this shout aloud O depths of the earth Break forth in song O mountains you forests and all your trees For the LORD has redeemed Jacob and revealed His glory in Israel

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ גֹּאֲלֶ֔ךָ וְיֹצֶרְךָ֖ מִבָּ֑טֶן אָנֹכִ֤י יְהוָה֙ עֹ֣שֶׂה כֹּ֔ל נֹטֶ֤ה לְבַדִּ֔י שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִי רֹקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ אִתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh gō·’ă·le·ḵā wə·yō·ṣer·ḵā mib·bā·ṭen ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ‘ō·śeh kōl nō·ṭeh lə·ḇad·dî šā·ma·yim mī rō·qa‘ hā·’ā·reṣ ʾit·tī
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer who formed you from the womb I am the LORD who has made all things who alone stretched out . . . the heavens who by Myself spread out the earth

verses.original: מֵפֵר֙ אֹת֣וֹת בַּדִּ֔ים יְהוֹלֵ֑ל וְקֹסְמִ֖ים מֵשִׁ֧יב אָח֖וֹר חֲכָמִ֛ים וְדַעְתָּ֥ם יְשַׂכֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mê·p̄êr ’ō·ṯō·wṯ bad·dîm yə·hō·w·lêl wə·qō·sə·mîm mê·šîḇ ’ā·ḥō·wr ḥă·ḵā·mîm wə·ḏa‘·tām yə·śak·kêl
verses.literal: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners who confounds . . . the wise and turns their knowledge into nonsense

verses.original: מֵקִים֙ דְּבַ֣ר עַבְדּ֔וֹ יַשְׁלִ֑ים וַעֲצַ֥ת מַלְאָכָ֖יו הָאֹמֵ֨ר לִירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם תּוּשָׁ֗ב וּלְעָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ תִּבָּנֶ֔ינָה אֲקוֹמֵֽם׃ וְחָרְבוֹתֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: mê·qîm də·ḇar ‘aḇ·dōw yaš·lîm wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ mal·’ā·ḵāw hā·’ō·mêr lî·rū·šā·lim tū·šāḇ ū·lə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh tib·bā·ne·nāh ’ă·qō·w·mêm wə·ḥā·rə·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: who confirms the message of His servant and fulfills the counsel of His messengers who says of Jerusalem She will be inhabited and of the cities of Judah They will be rebuilt and I will restore their ruins

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֥ר לַצּוּלָ֖ה חֳרָ֑בִי אוֹבִֽישׁ׃ וְנַהֲרֹתַ֖יִךְ
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mêr laṣ·ṣū·lāh ḥo·rā·ḇî ’ō·w·ḇîš wə·na·hă·rō·ṯa·yiḵ
verses.literal: who says to the depths of the sea Be dry and I will dry up your currents

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֤ר לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ רֹעִ֔י יַשְׁלִ֑ם וְכָל־ חֶפְצִ֖י וְלֵאמֹ֤ר לִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ תִּבָּנֶ֔ה וְהֵיכָ֖ל תִּוָּסֵֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mêr lə·ḵō·w·reš rō·‘î yaš·lim wə·ḵāl ḥep̄·ṣî wə·lê·mōr lî·rū·šā·lim tib·bā·neh wə·hê·ḵāl tiw·wā·sêḏ
verses.literal: who says of Cyrus My shepherd will fulfill all that I desire who says of Jerusalem She will be rebuilt and of the temple Let its foundation be laid
